boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Solano Campus places for studying, meeting, recreation, events, and waterfront breaks, verified through current university pages and the official campus map.

cards.title: Set Up for Solo or Group Work at the Library
cards.subtitle: Lower-campus study space with research help and shared resources
cards.notes: Bring coursework here for individual or group study, then use the service desk or virtual chat when research questions stall.
cards.short_summary: A lower-campus workspace combining study areas, research support, computers, Wi-Fi, and printing.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Poly states that the Solano campus library provides individual and group study space, research assistance, Wi-Fi, computers, and self-service printing.
cards.source_title: Library Services | Cal Poly Academic Catalog
cards.access_notes: Use during posted library hours; some materials, borrowing privileges, and licensed resources may require Cal Poly credentials.

cards.title: Use Mayo Hall Between Appointments and Meetings
cards.subtitle: Student-life center with lounges, study areas, and meeting rooms
cards.notes: Use the lounge or study areas between classes, or meet here before visiting the student-service offices housed in the building.
cards.short_summary: A renovated historic gym repurposed around student services, informal gathering, studying, and leadership work.
cards.evidence_claim: The university says Mayo Hall now contains student-oriented lounge, study, meeting, leadership, and student-service spaces.
cards.source_title: Mayo Hall Renovation and Addition Project
cards.access_notes: Building and room access may follow campus business hours, scheduled programs, or reservations; confirm locally before arranging a meeting.

cards.title: Split a Workout Across PEAC’s Fitness Spaces
cards.subtitle: Weight room, cardio room, and pool in one campus facility
cards.notes: Check the current recreation schedule, bring the required gear, and choose the weight room, cardio room, or pool for your session.
cards.short_summary: The campus recreation complex brings strength, cardio, and aquatic facilities under one roof.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Maritime identifies PEAC activities as including a weight room, cardio room, and pool; ASI lists PEAC among its managed student facilities.
cards.source_title: Associated Students | Cal Poly Maritime Academy
cards.access_notes: Facility participation is subject to current ASI schedules, eligibility rules, Port Pass requirements, and any pool safety restrictions.

cards.title: Meet Teammates on Bodnar Field
cards.subtitle: ASI-managed outdoor field for recreation and campus programs
cards.notes: Check the ASI calendar or field schedule before organizing a game, practice, or outdoor meetup so you do not conflict with programming.
cards.short_summary: A named athletic field used within the academy’s student recreation and event network.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Poly Maritime Academy says ASI manages Bodnar Field to support student connection and recreation; the official campus map labels it as location 35.
cards.source_title: Associated Students | Cal Poly Maritime Academy
cards.access_notes: Use depends on scheduled athletics, intramurals, events, field conditions, and current ASI facility rules.

cards.title: Take a Waterfront Reset at Morrow Cove
cards.subtitle: ASI-managed waterfront campus space
cards.notes: Use the cove as a meetup or outdoor pause, while staying within posted boundaries and leaving active waterfront operations undisturbed.
cards.short_summary: A distinctly maritime outdoor gathering place beside San Pablo Bay and the campus waterfront.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Poly Maritime Academy lists Morrow Cove as an ASI-managed campus space for students to connect and recharge; it is also named on the official campus map.
cards.source_title: Associated Students | Cal Poly Maritime Academy
cards.access_notes: Observe posted waterfront boundaries, weather conditions, event closures, and campus safety instructions; water access is not implied.

cards.title: Bring a Small Group to the Sport Courts
cards.subtitle: Outdoor courts managed for student recreation
cards.notes: Check court availability, bring the right ball or equipment, and use the space for an informal game when scheduled programs are clear.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated outdoor court area for active breaks, informal play, and organized recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: The academy says ASI manages the Sport Courts for student connection and activity; the official campus map names the site All Sports Courts.
cards.source_title: Associated Students | Cal Poly Maritime Academy
cards.access_notes: Court availability is subject to intramurals, programs, maintenance, weather, and current ASI rules.

cards.title: Use Formation Quad as the Clear Group Rally Point
cards.subtitle: Large named outdoor campus gathering area
cards.notes: Pick a specific edge or landmark before meeting here; the quad’s large capacity makes precise meetup instructions especially useful.
cards.short_summary: A central open space suited to large assemblies and clearly coordinated campus meetups.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Maritime’s official meeting-spaces page identifies Formation Quad as an outdoor space with a listed capacity of 750.
cards.access_notes: Formal events require coordination or reservation; routine access may change for formations, ceremonies, or campus operations.

cards.title: Choose Felton Garden for a Smaller Outdoor Meetup
cards.subtitle: Named garden beside the Charlotte Felton House
cards.notes: Use this smaller setting for a planned conversation or group pause, and verify that no reserved event is using the garden first.
cards.short_summary: A defined garden venue offering a more contained alternative to the campus’s broad lawns and quad.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Maritime’s official meeting-spaces page lists Felton Garden as an outdoor space with a capacity of 64.
cards.access_notes: Event use may require a reservation and fees; confirm availability with campus Conference and Events.

cards.title: Move the Conversation Outside the Dining Center
cards.subtitle: Named lawn for outdoor gatherings near campus dining
cards.notes: Meet on the lawn for an outdoor group check-in, but verify event bookings and keep service routes and building entrances clear.
cards.short_summary: A mapped gathering lawn that gives groups outdoor space beside a major daily campus destination.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Maritime’s official meeting-spaces page names the Lawn at Dining Center as an outdoor venue with a capacity of 200.
cards.access_notes: The lawn may be reserved for events; dining purchases and meal access are separate from use of the outdoor area.

cards.title: Take a Short Break at the Overlook
cards.subtitle: Named outdoor venue above the waterfront campus
cards.notes: Use the Overlook for a brief outdoor conversation or reset, then yield the space when a scheduled campus event is being prepared.
cards.short_summary: A compact named outdoor venue suited to pauses and small-group gatherings away from indoor rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Maritime’s official meeting-spaces page lists the Overlook among campus outdoor spaces and assigns it a capacity of 80.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the exact location on campus wayfinding and respect reservations, barriers, weather closures, and posted safety rules.

warnings: Several supporting facility pages remain on the university’s legacy csum.edu domain during the Cal Poly integration; all cited URLs are direct university pages.
Coordinates and Google Maps URLs are null because exact destination-level values were not verified from authoritative direct pages.
